Build notes

A portfolio in two formats.

The 3D experience expresses my interest in interactive visuals. The text pages make my background and projects easy to browse directly.

The interactive version

The main experience uses WebGL scenery, animation and audio. Its assets and scene components load through a JavaScript application.

The readable version

The About and Projects pages contain their text in the delivered HTML. You can read them without waiting for 3D models or using WebGL. Project descriptions come from the same profile file as the interactive gallery.

Project status matters

A hardware concept, an experiment and a deployed application are different kinds of work. Each project is labelled accordingly. Only projects with a known public deployment show a live-demo link.
